text:
maddie_marketing: Quick sync - want to run a compact PLG pilot for the pre-launch workshop. Goal: increase first-successful-prompt and shorten time-to-first-success.

maddie_marketing: Proposal:
- 3k free credits reserved for workshop signups (auto-enroll)
- Prompt pack (4 quick templates: summarize, reword, brainstorm, code-snippet) delivered at signup
- 3 nudges over 7 days (email, in-console toast, challenge)
- A/B/C: control / credits-only / credits+pack+nudges

leo_growth: routing? how to separate pilot signups from general funnel?

maddie_marketing: tag cohort=wkshp-pilot; auto enroll until 3k or 30 days.

anya_product: Primary metric = % that runs prompt.execute with template_id within 7d. Target = +6pp vs control. Secondary: 7d retention and avg tokens.

nina_analytics: i'll add experiment_id on events and build a dashboard. Need event hooks and SQL cohort.

sam_design: UI note: first-login modal with 3 featured templates and one-click "Try". i'll drop mocks by tomorrow.

leo_growth: allocation? if baseline ~18% we need power. suggest 25/37.5/37.5 so treatment arms have more users.

maddie_marketing: fine. will confirm budget and increase to 3k if finance ok.

anya_product: follow-ups: if no template use in 48h, queue soft demo invite + micro-webinar nudge.

eng_ops_bot: experiment created: exp.wkshp.1705009999 | cohorts: control/credits/full | allocation set | tag experiment_id=exp.wkshp.1705009999

maddie_marketing: Action items:
- maddie: confirm budget + update doc (today)
- sam: modal copy + mock (tomorrow)
- anya: follow-up rules (ETA Wed)
- nina: dashboard + power calc (ETA Wed)
- leo: manual outreach plan for top 200 signups

leo_growth: will prep outreach cadence.

nina_analytics: will post dashboard link when events flow.

maddie_marketing: unless objections i'll flip switch tomorrow morning. ping me with blockers. :seedling:
